sharedGraphicCalls.expression: <CadContextHelp label="DXF geometry source">
sharedGraphicCalls.containerText:
Geometry source

Sketch exports its local 2D contours, excluding construction geometry. Reference curve exports one open chain with its traversal preserved.

Section cuts a current final solid at the chosen plane and height, including downstream pockets and Boolean changes. It exports exact lines, circular arcs and circles. A solid silhouette or arbitrary projection is currently unavailable.

DXF is independent of CAD saving and CAM. Existing generated gear chords retain their declared approximation; export adds no tessellation.

sharedGraphicCalls.expression: <CadContextHelp label="Section offset">
sharedGraphicCalls.visibleText: Offset mm The plane moves along XY +Z XZ −Y +X . The initial value cuts through the middle of the selected body's bounds. Maximum curve deviation · mm helpSelection('tolerance', open)}>

Involute tooth flanks and rack-generated root transitions are mathematical curves, not circular arcs. This app represents them with short straight chords whose maximum deviation stays within the applied accuracy.

Root-circle and tip-circle arcs remain exact. A smaller accuracy value adds chords as needed; it does not set a fixed segment count. The same profile geometry feeds solids and DXF export.

Automatic accuracy uses min(0.005 mm, module / 200). Custom accuracy is preserved while Automatic is selected.

Maximum curve deviation · mm helpSelection('tolerance', open)}>

Involute tooth flanks and rack-generated root transitions are mathematical curves, not circular arcs. This app represents them with short straight chords whose maximum deviation stays within the applied accuracy.

Root-circle and tip-circle arcs remain exact. A smaller accuracy value adds chords as needed; it does not set a fixed segment count. The same profile geometry feeds solids and DXF export.

Automatic accuracy uses min(0.005 mm, module / 200). Custom accuracy is preserved while Automatic is selected.
